name: tether
description: Claude Code plugins: tether, project-neutral guards, telemetry and evals configured per project; and tether-nx, agents and skills for Angular and Nx workspaces.

plugins.name: tether
plugins.description: Project-neutral hooks and tools that read every project value from the project's .claude/harness.json; a project without that file gets no behaviour.

plugins.name: tether-nx
plugins.description: Opinionated agents and skills for Angular and Nx workspaces: library layers, route-scoped providers, signals over RxJS, and a planner, implementer and reviewer that follow them. A project overrides any rule in .claude/tether-nx.md.
